questions.question: Run through these on the installed build and mark each one. Add a comment on anything that failed.

items.label: Hotkey on another workspace
items.detail: On workspace 3, press Cmd+Ctrl+P. The window shows there, and AeroSpace doesn't switch workspaces.

items.label: Focus stays put
items.detail: Typing in the terminal, press the hotkey, answer with the keyboard, send. The terminal still has focus after.

items.label: Notification opens the card
items.detail: Start an ask with the window hidden. Clicking the notification shows the window with that card.

items.label: Tray count
items.detail: With two asks pending, the tray shows 2. It drops to 1 after answering one.

items.label: No Dock icon
items.detail: Parley is absent from the Dock and from Cmd+Tab, including right after launch.
